title: Real-bug review suite: blocking bugs no gstack review found first, plus decoys and home-field units (stage 1 counted draw: 54 non-gstack units by seed 2665 after AMENDMENT-2026-11-15, all H and N)
purpose: GST-2665: does gstack's code review catch real bugs better than a plain review prompt? Non-gstack units (S1, S2, S3) are ranked so the first N keep the mix; N units are decoys for false alarms; H units are home field, reported apart.
judging_rule: A blocker is FOUND when a finding rated CRITICAL after mapping names the same defect: a path the blocker lists and the same cause; the line may move. The same defect rated only INFORMATIONAL is DOWNGRADED, which is a miss. Otherwise it is MISSED.

shelf_life.rule: Each model's knowledge cutoff is recorded in the preregistration; a sensitivity line reads the newest half. No case is dropped for shelf life.

groups.S1: A human reviewer's comment on the PR, followed before merge by a commit that changed the lines it named.
groups.S2-openai: The same, from a review tool on an OpenAI model (partly home field for GPT cells).
groups.S2-google: The same, from a review tool on a Google model.
groups.S2-anthropic: The same, from a review tool on an Anthropic model.
groups.S2-mixed: The same, from a review tool whose vendor routes between labs or names none.
groups.S3: Escaped: a later fix PR points at this PR as the one that introduced the bug; the unit is this PR at its own head against its own base.
groups.N: Decoy: a merged PR whose added lines no commit touched for 90 days; read for false alarms only. Its one blocker is a bait.
groups.H-stacks-r1: Home field: gstack-evals stacks-r1 units, bugs gstack-family reviews found first. Reported apart, never in the headline.
groups.H-206: Home field: harness-evals #206 CRITICALs, gstack plus a second model family. Reported apart, never in the headline.
